title: Panel Ghost Interaction Mode
description: When UI interaction starts in a panel, active element stays visible, rest dims to 5% opacity, panel becomes click-through to canvas.
summary: Promoted ghost to global: GhostProvider on Layout with document capture-phase pointer detection (4px threshold) dims all PanelGhostRoot regions on any interaction (GIS window drag, map pan, panel controls). Active chain uses data-active-interaction (leaf) + data-active-ancestor (outer dims). PanelGhostRoot is a passive data-ghost-region shell; Ring/tree DnD/resize/setActiveInteraction hooks unchanged. globals-ui.css separates dim opacity from pointer-events. 139/142 ui/react tests pass (3 pre-existing tree layout failures).
